channel.description: Latest articles from Just A Pinch Recipes (justapinch.com)

item.title: Outback Steakhouse Alice Springs Chicken
item.description: When you can't go out to dinner, this recipe lets you recreate the steakhouse favorite at home. The homemade honey mustard makes this dish unique and delicious. Sweet and slightly tangy, its flavor soaks into the chicken breasts. Browning the chicken in bacon grease also adds a smoky flavor. Then it's topped with mushrooms, crumbled bacon, and a lot of cheese. Serve with a baked potato for a yummy meal. You'll have a lot of honey mustard left over that can be used for dipping.

item.title: Crock Pot Chicken and Dumplings
item.description: Preparing chicken and dumplings has never been easier. It's as simple as prepping the veggies, putting the ingredients into the slow cooker, and then letting the Crock Pot go to work. A short time before it's time to eat, shred the chicken and add the dumplings. The little pieces of dough puff into soft buttery pillows. The savory and lightly sweet sauce from the chicken soaks into the dumplings. A comforting meal the whole family will love.

item.title: Chocolate Pie With Peanut Butter Crust
item.description: One bite of this chocolate pie with a peanut butter crust and you'll think you're eating one of those famous Girl Scout cookies. It's a super-easy recipe that's perfect for kids to jump in on and lend a hand. Even though the Rice Krispies are crushed in the prep, you still get their crunch in each bite. Slices of the pie aren't the easiest to cut or the prettiest, but they're quite tasty.

item.title: Creamy Crock Pot Chicken With Pasta
item.description: If you need a quick-to-prep dinner recipe, try this creamy Crock Pot chicken with pasta. As long as chicken breasts are in the freezer, this recipe can be made with what's available in most kitchens. Combining cream of chicken soup, cream cheese, and butter creates a creamy and rich sauce. A packet of Italian seasoning adds a zesty zing. We served this chicken dinner over fettuccine pasta, but use your favorite or what's handy.

item.title: Southern Fried Cabbage
item.description: Frying cabbage in bacon drippings makes this Southern fried cabbage amazing. They coat the cabbage and help it cook to tender perfection. It's an old-fashioned way to cook cabbage. Adding diced jalapenos makes this recipe slightly different than others. They add a little bit of heat, but it's not overpowering. A delicious side dish.

item.title: Aunt Faye's Pound Cake
item.description: A box of butter cake mix makes it easy to whip up Aunt Faye's pound cake. Adding cake flour, sour cream, and extra eggs makes the pound cake taste as if it's from scratch. This pound cake is moist and tender. Vanilla extract, butter, and almond extracts add a depth of flavor. On top is a lemon glaze that's a tangy and sweet contrast to the rich pound cake.

item.title: Momma Linda's Enchiladas
item.description: These enchiladas may not be the prettiest, but boy, are they tasty! It's a no-frills dish with Tex-Mex flavor. They're not traditional enchiladas. Flour tortillas replace more traditional corn tortillas and are packed with ground beef, beans, and cheese. Chili on top replaces traditional enchilada sauce and adds tons of flavor to this simple dinner. Serve with beans and rice for a meal that will feed a crowd.

item.title: Oreo Cream Cheese Red Velvet Cupcakes
item.description: These are not only really pretty cupcakes, but they are delicious and will be a real crowd-pleaser. We loved the Oreo on the bottom. It's a hidden treat! The frosting is perfect and tastes like cookies and cream ice cream. Kids - big and small - are going to love these!

item.title: Apple Banana Bread
item.description: Adding apples takes banana bread to another level. We loved the bits of chopped apples throughout the moist and tender banana bread. There's just the right amount of ground cinnamon and nutmeg for a nice hit of spice. Enjoy this for breakfast, an afternoon snack, or a light dessert. It's a nice apple twist for fall.

item.title: Crock Pot Cheesy Hash Brown Casserole
item.description: This Crock Pot cheesy hash brown casserole is super easy and creamy. The tater tots break down into hash brown-like potatoes and look like a casserole. Preparing this side dish requires very little work. Creamy and cheesy, it could be a breakfast casserole or as a dinner side dish alongside chicken, steak, ribs, or pork chops.
